articles.title: Expansion of India's Global South Diplomacy through FIPIC 4.0
articles.summary: India reinforces its strategic commitment to Pacific Island Countries focusing on climate resilience, digital connectivity, and sustainable maritime infrastructure.
prelims: FIPIC (Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation) was launched in 2014, covering 14 Pacific Island nations.
Aligns with India's SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision and Indo-Pacific ocean initiative.
Focus areas include healthcare solarization, desalination plants, and disaster-resilient infrastructure.
articles.mains: Examine how India's strategic engagements with Pacific Island countries counter regional power imbalances while advancing sustainable blue economy goals.

articles.title: Operational Guidelines Issued for National Quantum Mission (NQM) T-Hubs
articles.summary: The Department of Science & Technology releases operationalization framework for setting up four thematic hubs to drive quantum technology R&D.
prelims: National Quantum Mission (NQM) spans from 2023-24 to 2030-31 under DST.
Focuses on 4 key domains: Quantum Computing, Quantum Communication, Quantum Sensing & Metrology, and Quantum Materials.
Aims to develop satellite-based secure quantum communications and high-capacity quantum computers.
articles.mains: Discuss the strategic importance of quantum technology in national security and evaluate how the NQM positions India in global high-tech supply chains.

articles.title: Rollout of Bio-E3 Policy for High-Performance Biomanufacturing
articles.summary: Government launches biomanufacturing hubs to accelerate circular bioeconomy solutions under the Bio-E3 framework.
prelims: Bio-E3 stands for Biotechnology for Economy, Environment, and Employment.
Targeted areas include bio-based products, functional foods, smart proteins, and carbon capture biomanufacturing.
Spearheaded by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) to support green transition goals.
articles.mains: How can the Bio-E3 policy catalyze India's transition towards a net-zero economy while fostering innovation-led employment?

articles.title: Supreme Court Directives on Rights of Forest Dwellers in Eco-Sensitive Zones
articles.summary: Apex court clarifies that Eco-Sensitive Zone (ESZ) declarations must harmoniously balance environmental conservation with the pre-existing rights under the FRA, 2006.
prelims: Eco-Sensitive Zones are notified under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 around National Parks and Sanctuaries.
Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006 recognizes individual and community rights of traditional forest dwellers.
Activities in ESZs are categorized into Prohibited, Regulated, and Permitted activities.
articles.mains: Analyze the potential conflicts between environmental conservation laws and indigenous community rights, suggesting measures for inclusive ecological governance.

articles.title: Global South Framework Endorses India's Digital Public Infrastructure Model
articles.summary: International agencies adopt India's open-source Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) framework to accelerate SDGs in developing economies.
prelims: DPI relies on three foundational pillars: Identity (Aadhaar), Payments (UPI), and Data Sharing (Account Aggregator).
Built on principles of open APIs, interoperability, and non-proprietary software architecture.
G20 Framework under India's presidency benchmarked DPI for global financial inclusion.
articles.mains: Evaluate India's potential to leverage Digital Public Infrastructure as an instrument of soft power and digital diplomacy in the Global South.
